claims.claim_text: The issuer is TradeFunded LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, per the Form C filed with the SEC (issuer-reported).

The Form C gives an incorporation date of 02-10-2026 (about eight months before the 2026-10-14 cutoff; the date format is presumably MM-DD-YYYY). The issuer is therefore a very new entity. Website listed: www.tradefunded.com.
claims.contradictions: See A12: the Form C reports prior-fiscal-year figures, including a net loss, for an entity said to be incorporated in Feb 2026.

claims.claim_text: The funding intermediary named in the Form C is OpenDeal Portal LLC (SEC file number 007-00167). The filing was initially accepted 2026-09-16. The pack could not verify the platform page, so availability is not confirmed.

The security is described in the Form C as type 'Other' with the description 'Units' (LLC units). The pack's checklist labels it 'equity', but the rights attached to the units (voting, distributions, transfer limits, information rights) are not described in any readable document.
claims.contradictions: The pack checklist says security_class=equity, while the Form C says 'Other/Units'. The two are not necessarily inconsistent, but the class of units is unspecified.

claims.claim_text: The stated price is $0.35 per unit. The price determination method is 'Arbitrary', meaning the issuer set it with no formula and no independent valuation. No valuation cap, discount or conversion terms appear in the readable pack. This is a priced unit offering, not a Crowd SAFE.
The target offering amount is $74,999.75, based on 214,285 units offered.
The maximum offering amount is $679,999.95, and oversubscription is accepted on a first-come, first-served basis. At $0.35 per unit, the maximum implies about 1,942,857 units.

The offering deadline is 12-15-2026, about two months after the 2026-10-14 cutoff. No closing has been reported. A future deadline does not prove the offering is open, and the pack could not verify availability on the platform.

citations.quote: the Issuer will pay the Intermediary a cash fee equal to the greater of $15,000 or a tiered calculation

claims.claim_text: The Form C says the issuer will pay the intermediary a cash fee equal to the greater of $15,000 or a tiered calculation (0% up to $100,000 raised, 6% from $100,000.01 to $5,000,000). It also says the issuer paid a non-refundable $15,000 fee. The field text is truncated in the filing, so the full fee terms are unknown. These are issuer-side fees. Investor-side fees are not shown.

citations.quote: The Intermediary will also receive compensation in the form of securities equal to two percent (2%) of the total number of the securities sold in the Offering.

claims.claim_text: The intermediary will also receive securities equal to 2% of the total securities sold in the offering. This adds dilution and gives the intermediary a financial interest in the issuer.

The company is pre-revenue. The Form C reports revenue of $0.00 for both the most recent and the prior fiscal year, with $0.00 cost of goods sold and $0.00 cash. The fiscal-year end dates are not stated in the readable pack, so the age and staleness of these figures cannot be assessed.
claims.financial_period: Most recent and prior fiscal years (dates not stated in pack); issuer-reported, unaudited status unknown

Net income was $0.00 for the most recent year and -$23,115 for the prior year. Cash is $0, so the assets are non-cash and their nature is unknown. A $0 net result alongside $226,885 of assets, and a prior-year loss for an entity incorporated in Feb 2026, are unexplained. Without the financial statements, these fields cannot be reconciled.
claims.contradictions: The incorporation date of 02-10-2026 (A2) sits uneasily with a reported prior-fiscal-year net loss of -$23,115 and a most-recent-year net income of $0.00. Fiscal-year definitions are not in the pack.
claims.financial_period: Most recent fiscal year (total assets, net income) and prior fiscal year (net income); dates not stated

additional_claims.claim_text: Business quality cannot be assessed from the pack. The unparsed tradef.pdf may contain the business description, but its contents are unknown, so nothing should be inferred about the business from the name alone.

Because the security is LLC units, any payout depends on the operating agreement, which is not readable. Whether the units carry distribution rights, voting rights or tradability is unverified. This is why the path to cash for an investor is unconfirmed.

business_model.assessment: The readable pack does not say what TradeFunded LLC does, who pays it or how it would earn money [A16]. The Form C shows only a website name, tradefunded.com [A2]. The name hints at something to do with trading or funding, but that is a guess and should not be treated as a finding. The company is pre-revenue, with $0 revenue in both reported fiscal years [A11, B4]. It has no employees and is run by its managers [A13]. The only substantive offering document, tradef.pdf, was not parsed [A15]. A business model assessment is therefore not possible from this pack [B5].

competition.assessment: Nothing on competitors, market size or differentiation is in the pack [A16]. I will not supply outside knowledge or market statistics. This section is unknown.

demand_evidence.assessment: No demand evidence is in the pack. There are no customers, users, contracts, letters of intent, waitlists or sales. Revenue is $0 in both reported years [A11]. For a pre-revenue company, stage-appropriate evidence would be product progress, pilots or customer interviews. None of that is readable, because the offering PDF was not parsed [A15]. The absence of evidence in the pack does not show that demand is absent.

economics_and_funding.assessment: The company is pre-revenue [B4]. It reports $0 cash, $0 debt and 0 employees for the most recent fiscal year, whose end date is not stated [A11, A13]. It reports total assets of $226,885, which are non-cash and of unknown nature [A12]. Net loss was -$23,115 in the prior year and $0 in the most recent year [A12]. These figures do not fit an entity incorporated on 02-10-2026 [A2, A12]. Without dated financial statements I cannot judge staleness or compute runway. The raise ranges from a $74,999.75 target to a $679,999.95 maximum [A6, A7]. The use of proceeds is not in the pack. On the issuer-side costs, the minimum intermediary cash fee of $15,000 is about 20% of the target raise [B2]. If the full maximum is raised, the 6% tier would imply roughly $34,800, but the fee text is truncated, so this is only a rough check [A9, B3]. The intermediary also receives units equal to 2% of units sold [A10, B3]. Whether the target raise would fund any real plan is unknown. The company has no cash and no employees, so the raise would be its first operating capital.

execution_risks.assessment: Main risks I can document. (1) The entity is very new, with a 02-10-2026 incorporation date, no revenue, no cash and no employees [A2, A11, A13]. (2) The financial fields cannot be reconciled with the incorporation date and are unexplained [A12]. (3) The key offering documents are unreviewed, so the business plan and the risk factors disclosed by the issuer are unseen [A15]. (4) The raise range is wide: the maximum is about nine times the target [B1]. A company that raises only the target may be underfunded, while one that raises the maximum has far more to deploy than the known team history supports. (5) Availability of the offering is unverified [A8]. Other risks, such as regulatory exposure in the business, cannot be assessed because the business is unknown.

price_and_terms.assessment: The price is $0.35 per unit, set by the 'Arbitrary' method, meaning no formula or independent valuation [A5]. The target of 214,285 units at $0.35 gives $74,999.75, which matches the stated target [A6, B1]. The maximum implies about 1,942,857 units [A7]. The implied valuation cannot be computed because the number of units outstanding is not in the pack, so an investor cannot tell what percentage of the company $0.35 buys. Dilution: the intermediary receives units equal to 2% of units sold, and oversubscription is first-come, first-served [A7, A10, B3]. The minimum investment, investor fees, voting and information rights, transfer limits and repurchase rights are not found [A17]. Price and terms are assessed separately from business quality: on the available evidence, neither the price nor the contract can be judged reasonable or unreasonable.

security_path_to_proceeds.assessment: The security is LLC 'Units' [A4]. It is not a Crowd SAFE, and there is no cap or conversion mechanism in the readable pack [A5]. An investor could receive cash from three routes: (1) distributions of profit from the LLC; (2) a sale or liquidation of the company, with payout under the LLC agreement; (3) a resale of units to another buyer. All of this depends on contract terms that are not readable (unit class, distribution waterfall, transfer limits, information rights, manager control) [A15, A17, B6]. What usually prevents cash: a pre-revenue company has no profit to distribute; LLC units are typically hard to resell and may be restricted by the operating agreement; managers may control distribution timing; and many early companies fail or never reach a sale. These are general considerations, not facts found in the pack. As units of an LLC, they may also carry tax reporting consequences that I cannot assess from the pack. The path to proceeds is unverified.

team_evidence.assessment: Three people signed the Form C: Christopher Price as Chief Executive Officer, and Ryan Masten, Christopher Price and David Lojko as Manager Representatives [A14]. No biographies, prior roles or execution history are in the readable pack, so the team cannot be assessed. The company has no employees, so these managers are the whole organization [A13].

additional_claims.claim_text: The Form C reports a prior-fiscal-year net loss of -$23,115 for an entity whose stated incorporation date is 02-10-2026 and whose signatures are dated 09-16-2026. Whoever paid those expenses is not shown (for example member contributions or affiliate payments). additional_claims.financial_period: Prior fiscal year (end date not stated in pack)

additional_claims.claim_text: The incorporation date 02-10-2026 can only be read as MM-DD-YYYY (10 February 2026). Read as DD-MM-YYYY it would be 2 October 2026, which is after the 09-16-2026 signature dates in the same filing. This supports A2's presumption, so the entity is about eight months old at the cutoff. The date is still issuer-reported.

issues.explanation: The Form C gives an incorporation date of 02-10-2026 and signatures dated 09-16-2026. It also reports a prior-fiscal-year net loss (-$23,115) and prior-year total assets of $0. A completed 'prior fiscal year' is hard to square with an entity formed about seven months before filing. A and B flag this, but A18 and B still describe the company as 'newly formed' and give its financial figures as if they were reliable. The pack cannot say which is wrong: the incorporation date, the fiscal-year labels, a predecessor or short-period reporting, or a data-entry error. Until the dated statements are read, the Form C financial fields should be treated as low-reliability. They should not be used as support for any gate.
issues.target: A2/A12/A18: reported financial fields vs. incorporation date

issues.explanation: The fee field is cut off mid-sentence ('non-refundable $15,000 u'). A9 and B2 describe it as a fee already paid, as if the meaning were known. It may be a separate payment on top of the $15,000 minimum, or it may be credited against it. If it is additional, issuer-side fees at the target could be about 40% of the target rather than 20% (C2). Separately, B3's calculation lists only the units input. The ~$34,800 cash-fee figure is not backed by a calculation block, and the 6% tier's base ('funds raised') is itself ambiguous. Treat the 20% and $34,800 figures as illustrative only. Net proceeds to the issuer are unknown.

Nothing in the pack shows that this is the company's first capital. The prior-year loss of $23,115 coexists with $0 assets and $0 debt, so someone funded those expenses. The source is not shown (member contributions, an affiliate, or an accounting entry) (C4). Likewise, 'operated by its managers only' (A13) and 'these managers are the whole organization' (B team_evidence) go beyond the 0-employee field. Contractors, affiliates or a parent entity may do the work. Drop both statements or label them as inference.
issues.target: B economics_and_funding: 'the raise would be its first operating capital'

issues.explanation: B says a maximum raise gives the company 'far more to deploy than the known team history supports'. B also says a target-only raise 'may be underfunded'. Team history is entirely unknown (A14), and use of proceeds and the budget are unknown. Neither statement can be evaluated. They sound like findings but are speculation. The only supported point is the 9.07x spread between target and maximum (B1).
issues.target: B execution_risks: raise range vs. team history

issues.explanation: The claims that LLC units are typically hard to resell, that managers may control distribution timing, and that tax reporting consequences may apply come from general knowledge. They are not in the pack. B labels them as general, which is right, but they are not evidence about THIS security. They must not be used for or against a gate. The only pack-based fact is that the security is 'Other/Units' (A4). Whether the units carry distribution rights, voting rights or transferability is unknown.

Cash and receivables are $0, and there is no debt. The $226,885 is therefore some other asset. It could be capitalized software, intangible assets, contributed property or an entry error. This is one of the few facts that could change the view of the company, because the asset base is the only sign of work done. It is also what a pre-money valuation would need to be compared against. The pack cannot resolve it. 'Non-cash' is derived by elimination from the cash and receivable fields.

The Form C says 'Other/Units', which confirms only the form field. The unit class, rights and the pack's 'equity' label are unspecified. Marking security_type as fully confirmed is generous. It is better described as 'partly confirmed: label only'. The statement in A5 that this is 'a priced unit offering, not a Crowd SAFE' rests on the price field and the word 'Units', with no contract text. It is probably right but unverified. Without the unit count outstanding or a cap table, the implied valuation and the percentage ownership that $0.35 buys cannot be computed.
issues.target: critical_items: security_type marked confirmed_with_citation; A5 'not a Crowd SAFE'

issues.explanation: The initial acceptance date (2026-09-16) and 'no closing reported' come from pack metadata (offering record), not from a quoted page. A15 is marked document_supported_fact with no citation. These are acceptable as pack-metadata statements, but the status labels should say so. Availability stays unknown, and a platform page was not reachable.

Five of the seven critical items are not confirmed (operative contract, price/cap/conversion terms, minimum investment and fees, financial statements and dates, availability). evidence_sufficiency therefore cannot be 'pass'. Business_thesis and price_and_contract should be 'unknown', not 'fail'. The cause is that the only substantive document (about 61.7 MB) was not parsed, not that adverse evidence was found. Stage D should not read absence of text as proof of a weak business. The one adverse item that does have evidence is the unexplained fiscal-year inconsistency (C1).

briefing_ko.failure_reasons: 확인된 위험은 다음과 같습니다. 회사가 신생이고 현금이 $0이며 직원이 없습니다 [A2][A11][A13]. 설립일과 '직전 회계연도 순손실 -$23,115'가 맞지 않아 재무 수치를 믿기 어렵습니다 [A12][C1]. 가격이 '임의' 결정이라 근거가 되는 기업가치가 공시되지 않았습니다 [A5]. 중개업체 수수료가 목표액의 20%~40% 수준일 수 있어(수수료 문구가 잘려 불확실) 실제 사업에 쓸 돈이 줄 수 있습니다 [B2][C2]. 중개업체가 판매 유닛의 2%를 추가로 받아 희석됩니다 [A10]. 사업 실패 가능성 자체는 사업 내용을 모르므로 평가하지 못했습니다.
briefing_ko.future_evidence: tradef.pdf 전문을 읽어 사업 설명, 위험 요소, 자금 사용, 팀 이력, 운영계약을 확인하면 평가가 크게 달라질 수 있습니다. 날짜가 있는 재무제표와 설립일 불일치에 대한 설명, 자본 구성표(총 유닛 수), 플랫폼 페이지에서의 진행 상황도 필요합니다. 이후 제출되는 Form C/A, C-U, C-AR의 수정·진행 정보도 참고가 됩니다. 이 노트는 불확실성이 큰 선별용 자료이며 투자 결정은 사용자의 몫입니다.
briefing_ko.investor_proceeds_path: 이 증권은 LLC 유닛이며 전환 가능 증권(Crowd SAFE)이 아니라 '가격이 정해진 유닛'으로 보입니다 [A4][A5]. 투자자가 현금을 받을 수 있는 경로는 일반적으로 이익 분배, 회사 매각·청산 때의 배분, 유닛 재판매입니다. 그러나 유닛의 권리와 분배·양도 조건이 담긴 계약서를 읽지 못해 이 경로가 실제로 가능한지 확인되지 않았습니다 [A15][A17][B6]. 매출이 없는 회사는 분배할 이익이 없습니다.
briefing_ko.price_and_contract: 가격은 유닛당 $0.35이고 결정 방식은 '임의(Arbitrary)', 즉 공식이나 독립 평가 없이 회사가 정한 것입니다 [A5]. 발행 유닛 총수가 없어 $0.35로 회사 지분의 몇 %를 사는지 계산할 수 없습니다 [A5][C-검토]. 기업가치 상한(valuation cap)이나 할인 같은 조건은 읽을 수 있는 자료에 없습니다. 최소 투자금, 투자자 수수료, 의결권, 정보 공개 권리, 양도 제한, 회사의 재매입 권리도 확인되지 않았습니다 [A17]. 초과 청약은 선착순입니다 [A7].
briefing_ko.strongest_evidence: 긍정적으로 볼 만한 확인된 사실은 제한적입니다. 발행인, 중개업체(OpenDeal Portal), 가격, 목표액, 최대액, 마감일(2026-12-15)이 SEC 신고서(Form C)에 일관되게 기재되어 있습니다 [A1][A3][A5][A6][A7][A8]. 총자산 $226,885가 신고되었으나 성격이 불명이고 재무 필드의 신뢰도가 낮아 강한 증거로 보지 않습니다 [A12]. 사전 매출 단계에서는 매출 0 자체가 결격 사유는 아닙니다 [B4].
briefing_ko.summary: TradeFunded LLC는 2026년 2월에 설립되었다고 신고한 델라웨어 유한책임회사(LLC)로, 유닛(지분 단위)을 1유닛당 $0.35에 팔아 최소 약 $75,000, 최대 약 $680,000을 모으려 합니다 [A1][A2][A5][A6][A7]. 이 회사는 매출이 없는 사전 매출 단계입니다 [A11]. 핵심 문서(tradef.pdf)가 용량 때문에 분석되지 않아 사업 내용, 계약 조건, 자금 사용 계획, 팀 이력을 확인하지 못했습니다 [A15]. 따라서 이 노트는 '검토할 가치가 있는지'를 판단할 근거가 부족하다는 결과이며, 투자 조언이 아닙니다.
briefing_ko.unknowns: 사업 내용, 고객, 경쟁, 시장 [A16]. 자금 사용 계획. 팀원(Christopher Price, Ryan Masten, David Lojko)의 경력 [A14]. 계약 전문 [A15]. 회계연도 종료일과 재무제표의 검토·감사 여부 [A11]. 자산 $226,885의 정체 [A12]. 직전 연도 손실을 누가 부담했는지 [C4]. 오퍼링이 현재 열려 있는지와 모금액 [A8].
briefing_ko.what_it_does: 읽을 수 있는 자료에는 이 회사가 무엇을 하고 누가 돈을 내는지에 대한 설명이 없습니다 [A16]. 웹사이트 주소(tradefunded.com)만 있으며, 이름으로 사업을 추측하지 않았습니다 [A2]. 매출은 두 회계연도 모두 $0입니다 [A11]. 직원은 0명으로 신고되었습니다 [A13].

critique_responses.response: 수용합니다. 설립일(2026-02-10)과 직전 회계연도 순손실(-$23,115)은 맞추기 어렵고, 원인(단기 보고, 전신 사업, 라벨 오류, 입력 오류)을 팩으로 알 수 없습니다. Form C 재무 필드는 신뢰도가 낮은 것으로 취급하고 어떤 게이트의 지지 근거로도 쓰지 않았습니다. 이 불일치는 증거 부족 게이트의 반증으로만 사용했습니다.
수용합니다. 수수료 필드가 중간에 잘려 있어 기납부 $15,000이 최소 수수료와 별개인지 겹치는지 알 수 없습니다. 20%와 $34,800은 예시 수치일 뿐이고, 별개일 경우 약 40%(C2)가 될 수 있습니다. B3의 $34,800은 계산 블록이 불완전하므로 확정 수치로 쓰지 않습니다. 순조달액은 불명입니다.
수용합니다. '이번 조달이 첫 운영자금'이라는 문장과 '관리자만이 전체 조직'이라는 문장은 근거가 없어 철회합니다. 직원 0명 필드는 계약자나 계열사의 작업 가능성을 배제하지 않습니다. 전년도 손실을 누가 부담했는지도 알 수 없습니다(C4).
수용합니다. 최대 조달 시 '팀 이력 대비 과다'라거나 목표만 조달 시 '자금 부족'이라는 서술은 추측이므로 철회합니다. 팀 이력과 자금 사용 계획이 불명이라 평가할 수 없습니다. 지지되는 사실은 최대액이 목표액의 약 9.07배라는 점뿐입니다.
수용합니다. LLC 유닛의 일반적 특성(양도 어려움, 관리자의 분배 재량, 세무 보고)은 팩 밖의 일반 지식이라 이 증권에 대한 증거가 아닙니다. 어떤 게이트에도 쓰지 않았습니다. 팩에서 확인되는 것은 증권 유형이 '기타/유닛'이라는 점뿐입니다.
수용합니다. 총자산 $226,885는 현금·매출채권이 0이라는 점에서 소거법으로 '비현금'이라 본 것이며, 자본화된 소프트웨어, 무형자산, 출자 자산, 입력 오류 중 무엇인지 알 수 없습니다. 이 자산은 가치 비교와 사업 진척 판단에 핵심이지만 팩으로는 해결되지 않아 미확인 사항에 남겼습니다.
수용합니다. security_type은 '라벨만 부분 확인'으로 낮춰 봅니다. 유닛의 종류와 권리가 불명이고, 'Crowd SAFE가 아니다'라는 서술도 가격 필드와 'Units'라는 단어에 근거한 합리적 추정일 뿐 계약으로 확인되지 않았습니다. 유닛 총수가 없어 내재 기업가치와 지분율은 계산할 수 없습니다.
수용합니다. 최초 접수일(2026-09-16)과 '종결 보고 없음'은 팩의 오퍼링 메타데이터에서 온 것이며 인용된 페이지 문구가 아닙니다. A15도 인용 없이 팩의 gaps 항목에 근거합니다. 가용성은 계속 미확인입니다.

일부 수용합니다. 일곱 개 핵심 항목 중 확정된 것은 신원 정보뿐이고 증권 유형은 라벨만 확인되어, evidence_sufficiency는 pass가 될 수 없습니다. 이 게이트는 증거가 없다는 이유로 fail로 두되, 불리한 증거가 있어서가 아님을 명시했습니다. business_thesis와 price_and_contract는 증거 부재가 약한 사업을 뜻하지 않으므로 unknown으로 두었습니다.

forecasts.outcome_definition: TradeFunded LLC(CIK 0002128340)가 2026-10-14 이후 2027-04-14까지 이 오퍼링(file number 020-37393)에 대해 Form C/A, C-U, C-W, C-AR 중 하나 이상을 EDGAR에 제출한다.
forecasts.probability_basis: 마감일(2026-12-15)이 가까워 오퍼링 상태 변경이나 수정 공시가 나올 가능성이 있다는 판단이다. 통계에 근거하지 않은 주관적 추정이다.
forecasts.resolution_evidence: SEC EDGAR의 해당 발행인 제출 목록에서 접수일이 해당 기간 내인 Form C 계열 문서.
forecasts.unknown_treatment: EDGAR를 확인하지 못했거나 목록이 불완전하면 '미해결'로 처리하며, 공시 부재를 사건 실패로 계산하지 않는다.

forecasts.outcome_definition: 2026-10-14부터 2027-04-14 사이에 제출된 Form C/A 또는 Form C-AR이 총자산, 순손익, 설립일 등 재무 필드를 이 Form C와 다르게 보고한다.
forecasts.probability_basis: 재무 필드와 설립일의 불일치(C1)가 정정될 가능성은 있으나, 정정 공시가 나올지 자체가 불확실하다는 주관적 판단이다.
forecasts.resolution_evidence: EDGAR에 제출된 Form C/A 또는 C-AR의 재무 필드를 이 Form C(접수 2026-09-16)와 비교.
forecasts.unknown_treatment: 해당 기간에 관련 서류가 제출되지 않으면 '해결 불가'로 처리하며 사건 실패로 보지 않는다.

criteria_applied: 일곱 가지 핵심 항목이 모두 인용과 함께 확인되어야 pass 가능
핵심 항목 중 하나라도 미확인이면 pass 불가
읽을 수 있는 문서 범위가 사업·계약·재무 평가에 충분한지
gates.uncertainty: 유일한 실질 문서(tradef.pdf, 약 61.7MB)가 분석되지 않았습니다. 이 결과는 불리한 증거가 발견되었다는 뜻이 아니라 증거가 부족하다는 뜻입니다. 해당 PDF를 읽으면 결과가 크게 달라질 수 있습니다. 재무 필드와 설립일 간 불일치(C1)는 별도로 확인이 필요합니다.

criteria_applied: 사업 내용, 고객, 비용 부담자가 문서로 설명되는지
사전 매출 단계에 맞는 증거(제품 진척, 파일럿, 팀 이력) 존재 여부
gates.uncertainty: 사업 설명, 시장, 경쟁, 트랙션, 자금 사용 계획, 팀 이력이 모두 팩에 없습니다. 매출 0은 사전 매출 단계로 보면 그 자체가 불리한 증거는 아닙니다. 웹사이트 이름만으로 사업을 추정하지 않았습니다.

criteria_applied: 실제 계약 문서(운영계약 또는 청약계약)로 경제 조건이 확인되는지
가격이 공시된 기업가치나 지분 비율과 연결되는지
의결권, 정보권, 양도 제한, 분배 조건
gates.uncertainty: 가격 $0.35는 '임의(Arbitrary)' 결정이고 발행 유닛 총수가 없어 내재 기업가치와 지분율을 계산할 수 없습니다. 유닛의 종류와 권리, 최소 투자금, 투자자 수수료를 알 수 없습니다. 중개업체 수수료 문구는 잘려 있어 실제 순조달액도 불명확합니다. 2% 증권 보상으로 희석이 있습니다.
